account_no.description: Exact operator-verified lb_papertrading account number. Cannot change on an existing ledger.

broker_home.description: Absolute HOME containing the dedicated Longbridge paper-account login.

profile.description: Must be spy_cash: the explicit opt-in to automatic official-paper SPY market execution requested by a Worker task.

access_region.description: SPY SDK official access point: global or cn; omitted value global. Select cn when the server uses the mainland-China network. No endpoint override or automatic fallback.

oauth_client_id.description: Separately authorized official SDK OAuth client; never decrypt CLI credentials.

sdk_python_path.description: Absolute Python interpreter with official Longbridge SDK 5.2.0.

max_order_bps.description: SPY order step as basis points of current cash plus SPY market value, 1-10000; omitted value 1000 (10%). Includes 1% sizing reserve; not a market-price guarantee.

cash_buffer_bps.description: SPY profile cash reserve, 1-2000 basis points; omitted value 200.

drift_bps.description: SPY allocation no-trade band, 0-1000 basis points; omitted value 100.

quote_max_age_seconds.description: SPY execution quote freshness, 1-120 seconds; omitted value 60.

opening_shares.description: SPY profile: the SPY shares already held when this ledger starts, acknowledged by the operator; non-negative integer, omitted value 0. Must equal the broker's holding at the first reconciliation; immutable per ledger.

exposes_tools.name: spy.plan
exposes_tools.description: SPY/cash profile only. Planner-only: persist an immutable target allocation with captured research/market sources and validity in the App ledger. Never reads or writes the broker. Then declare a read-only codex Worker task whose goal names the decision_id. One unresolved target per account. Each decision executes at most one configured allocation step (default 10% of account value); whole shares, cash reserve and a drift band affect achieved ratio.

decision_id.description: 1-55 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, so the Worker task key spy-exec-<decision_id> is valid.

exposes_tools.name: spy.execute
exposes_tools.description: SPY/cash profile only. Worker-only: durably request execution of the exact persisted, unexpired, queued decision (state becomes requested) and wake the App's background loop; this call itself never contacts the broker. The loop reconciles, then submits at most one regular-session DAY SPY.US market order to the pinned official PAPER account with no per-order confirmation; the App computes integer shares and cash-only sizing. Repeating the request for a requested decision records nothing; any other state is refused. Poll plugin_dev_neige_paper_trading_spy_status until the decision is settled, noop, rejected, canceled, expired or unknown, or until your stated limit; a requested decision's error says why it is waiting. Uncertain submissions are NEVER resubmitted.

exposes_tools.name: spy.status
exposes_tools.description: Read persisted SPY/cash snapshot (price, quote time, market_open, and the broker calendar for calendar_date, the New York date it was read for: trading_day, half_day, regular_close_at), targets, order identities, actual fills and errors without contacting the broker. Check snapshot time. Requires host-provided owning Track and Planner/Worker identity.

exposes_tools.name: spy.refresh
exposes_tools.description: Wake the App's background loop to read the broker and atomically reconcile SPY allocation orders/fills; returns the persisted status immediately. Never submits. Poll plugin_dev_neige_paper_trading_spy_status for the new snapshot time. Unknown broker outcomes remain blocked until exact order identity is recovered.
